variants.name: current (tt_wrapper.py on the VAPWR tile, receiver area reserved)
variants.note:
Today's tile from layout/gen/tt_wrapper.py, moved onto the VAPWR template (tt_analog_2x2_pgvaa.def, 693.28 µm wide, every pin 17.92 µm further left than in the wrapper's 711.20 µm tile): every block and stripe shifted 17.92 µm left with the pins, except the macro, which stays at x 0.6 (it would leave the tile). The stripes that fed vco_top, mdac and the code inverters are VAPWR now; tx_drv's and the macro's stay VDPWR. Positions: node layout/floorplan/page/check.js --current.
The largest free rectangle off the wrapper's routes is reserved for the receiver: 517 × 46 µm at (176, 256). The receiver (rx_top, 299.4 × 370.6 µm, or 70.4k µm² of cells) fits nowhere in this tile as it is.

variants.name: A: no re-harden: macro as it is on the right edge, vco_top split
variants.note:
No re-harden: the macro as it is (170 × 260 µm), mirrored onto the right edge so its DAC pins face west. vco_top split: cgm_ref stands on end (MXR90) between mdac and the macro, the ring + lsdiv unit at the bottom next to the receiver's Q level shifter (a2 → aq 3 µm). The analog blocks' pins are fitted to this placement (a re-layout each); the macro's are not.
Numbers: RX input 212 µm from the macro and clocks; LNA inputs 3 µm; tx_drv on its pads; longest DAC line 196 µm; vg 18 µm.
Open: vbnf / vctrl from cgm_ref 51 / 52 µm and close to the DAC lines (rule 11); ls → rx 121 µm; vctrl → ua[0] 268 µm; ls, ck and the enables cross the receiver's LO end (rule 6).
Debug mux on ua[0]: four own 3.3 V tgates (estimated 15 × 12 µm, hatched) for baseband I, baseband Q, nb and vctrl, 1 µm at most from their sources (xdbg_bbi, xdbg_bbq, xdbg_nb, xdbg_vctrl drawn inside the source block); the bus to ua[0] is 1434 µm in all, routed round the receiver.

variants.name: B: squarish macro top right (250 × 177), vco_top split, every pin fitted
variants.note:
A squarish re-harden (250 × 177 µm, 1.4:1, against 1.5:1 as hardened) in the top-right corner, its DAC pins on the west edge right against mdac (longest DAC line 16 µm). vco_top split: the ring + lsdiv unit in the middle, cgm_ref flat under the macro. Every pin fitted (the macro's: a new pin_order.cfg).
Numbers: RX input 210 µm from the macro and clocks; a2 → aq 10 µm, ls → rx 63 µm; LNA inputs 3 µm; tx_drv on its pads; vg 3 µm.
Open: rx_bias ended up at the far right (nb / enb run across the tile) and q_i / q_q are 389 / 334 µm to uo[4] / uo[5]: drag the bias and the limiters back; vbnf 47 µm (rule 11); en_p / en_n and rx_en cross the receiver (rule 6).
Debug mux on ua[0]: four own 3.3 V tgates (estimated 15 × 12 µm, hatched) for baseband I, baseband Q, nb and vctrl, 4 µm at most from their sources (xdbg_bbi, xdbg_vctrl drawn inside the source block); the bus to ua[0] is 1093 µm in all, routed round the receiver. Limiter I was lifted off the ua[0] pad (it sat on it), leaving limiter Q 1.4 µm from the ring unit (rule 9).

variants.name: C: macro as hardened but turned 90° (260 × 170) top right, pins re-ordered
variants.note:
The macro at its hardened size but turned 90° (260 × 170 µm) in the top-right corner: only the pin order changes at the re-harden, not the shape. DAC pins against mdac (16 µm). vco_top split with cgm_ref abutting the ring unit again (vbnf 11 µm, vctrl 5 µm). Every pin fitted.
Numbers: RX input 210 µm from the macro and clocks; a2 → aq 3 µm, ls → rx 64 µm; LNA inputs 3 µm; tx_drv on its pads.
Open: limiter I ended up at the far right edge (q_i 669 µm to uo[4]): drag it back next to baseband I; mdac.vg → ring 134 µm (rule 7); the enables cross the receiver (rule 6).
Debug mux on ua[0]: four own 3.3 V tgates (estimated 15 × 12 µm, hatched) for baseband I, baseband Q, nb and vctrl, 4 µm at most from their sources (xdbg_bbi, xdbg_bbq, xdbg_nb drawn inside the source block); the bus to ua[0] is 971 µm in all, routed round the receiver.

variants.name: P3: RX left in two rows, VCO along the bottom, flat macro top right
variants.note:
The best of the three on the checklist: rules 1-4 and 8-10 pass. The receiver as cells on the left: the LNA on ua[4] / ua[5], the mixer column and LO buffers beside it, the two baseband arms in a row above, the limiters to their right. vco_top along the bottom right (R0), its LO end next to the receiver's LO column: a2 → aq 32 µm, ls → rx 62 µm. tx_drv between the LNA and vco_top on ua[2] / ua[3] (54 µm). The macro re-hardened flat (345 × 128 µm) across the top right, 151 µm of clearance from the LNA; its DAC pins moved to its south edge over mdac.
Open: the DAC lines (longest 286 µm) and mdac.vg → vco_top.vg (114 µm) are long (rule 7 warns); en_p / en_n from ui_in[5:6] cross baseband I (rule 6: route them round); several blocks' nearest supply stripe is the other rail (rule 5: move the stripes). Needs a macro re-harden (345 µm wide, DAC pins on its south edge) and an rx_top re-layout to this shape.

variants.name: B - Matt's edit, tidied
variants.note:
Matt's edit of B (cgm_ref along the bottom right under the macro, rx_bias tucked in beside limiter I, the space under the macro freed), tidied by Claude: pins of cgm_ref, the ring unit and rx_bias refitted for their new places, the debug switches re-placed (vctrl 1 µm from its source), decap refilled, stripes redone. No fails.
The cost of the move: cgm_ref is now ~100 µm from the ring, so vbnf (108 µm) and vctrl (99 µm) are real wires; they run down past limiter Q, and ck (f/4) leaves the ring unit right beside vbnf (rule 11). Idea: put limiter Q in the freed space under the macro and lift cgm_ref up against the ring unit.

variants.name: B - Matt's edit, cgm_ref against the ring
variants.note: Experiment from 'B - Matt's edit, tidied': only limiter Q, cgm_ref, rx_bias, vctrl_pd, the code inverters and the VDD_LS decap were free to move, to bring cgm_ref back against the ring. Limiter Q went to the bottom right beside limiter I and cgm_ref up under the macro: vctrl 57 µm, vbnf 90 µm (were 99 / 108), but rx_bias sits between the ring and cgm_ref, and the debug buses detour more (rule 6 +452 µm, warn). A partial gain only.
